name: Hoshikawa Hisame
source: Hisame is often percieved by the other girls as lazy, since she spends a lot of time sleeping on the job. However, she views herself as a nonconformist, citing her troubled past in the post-apocalyptic religious cult "Dominion", which she ran away from.
translation: Hisame is often percieved by the other girls as lazy, since she spends a lot of time sleeping on the job. However, she views herself as a nonconformist, citing her troubled past in the post-apocalyptic religious cult "Dominion", which she ran away from.
